accessory.title: Accessory
accessory.text: A gear special rule. Accessory gear may be worn in addition to armor on a hit location. Each accessory specifies the hit location it covers.

activation limit.title: Activation Limit: X
activation limit.text: A gear special rule. A survivor may only activate/spend (a) on this gear the listed number of times during a showdown.

affinity bonus.title: Affinity Bonus
affinity bonus.text: A type of gear special rule. Having the indicated number of colored affinities will trigger the effect. Each affinity bonus only applies once, regardless of how many extra affinities a survivor has.

ammo - bow.title: Ammo - Bow
ammo - bow.text: A gear special rule. You must have a bow in your gear grid to activate this card. Ammo has the range of a bow in your gear grid.

barbed.title: Barbed X
barbed.text: A gear special rule. On a Perfect hit, gain +X strength for the rest of the attack.

blindside.title: Blindside
blindside.text: A gear special rule. When you wound the monster from its blind spot with this gear, all of its <R> REFLEX become <R> FAILURE until the attack ends. (This includes the current reaction.)

block.title: Block X
block.text: A gear special rule. Spend (a) to ignore X hits the next time you are attacked. Lasts until your next act. A survivor may not use block more than once per attack. When you Block X, lose all deflect tokens.

charge.title: Charge
charge.text: A gear special rule. Survivors spend movement and activation to move the maximum available spaces in a straight line in one direction. At the end of movement, if in range, perform an attack using a melee weapon, adding the number of spaces moved in this way to your strength for the attack. Charge does not impact any further attacks this turn.

cleavage.title: Cleavage X
cleavage.text: A gear special rule. When you attempt to wound a hit location with a persistent injury, gain +X luck for that wound attempt.

cleave.title: Cleave
cleave.text: A gear special rule. You may spend MA to activate and attack with this weapon. If you do, it gains the two-handed keyword, +4 strength, and slow for the attack. You cannot use Cleave if an injury or other effect is preventing you from activating gear with the two-handed keyword.

clobber.title: Clobber X
clobber.text: A gear special rule. Gain +X strength while attempting to wound a Super-Dense hit location.

consume.title: Consume
consume.text: A special rule. Something that may be ingested for the listed result. It may be archived after use.

cumbersome.title: Cumbersome
cumbersome.text: A gear special rule. Survivors must spend both movement and activation to activate Cumbersome gear.

cursed.title: Cursed
cursed.text: A gear special rule. This gear cannot be removed from the gear grid for any reason. If the survivor dies or ceases to exist, archive this gear.

dazed.title: Dazed
dazed.text: When a monster or survivor is dazed, they gain -1 speed token until the end of their turn. Monsters and survivors can only be dazed once per round.

deadly.title: Deadly X
deadly.text: A gear special rule. Gain +X luck while attacking with this weapon. This increases the odds of inflicting critical wounds. (If no numerical value is specified, aka Deadly, it is just +1 luck.)

deflect.title: Deflect X
deflect.text: A gear special rule. Spend (a) to gain (or lose) deflect tokens until you have X of them. When you are hit, if you have any deflect tokens, you ignore that hit and lose a deflect token. When you Deflect X, you lose the benefits of Block.

devastating.title: Devastating X
devastating.text: A gear special rule. When a devastating weapon wounds a monster, it will inflict X additional wounds.

early iron.title: Early Iron
early iron.text: A gear special rule. When any of your attack roll results are a 1, cancel your attack.

ethereal.title: Ethereal
ethereal.text: A gear special ability. This gear is inextricably linked to saviors. When the settlement has no savior, archive this gear.

frail.title: Frail
frail.text: A gear special rule. Frail weapons are destroyed if a survivor attempts to wound a Super-dense location with them. Archive the weapon at the end of the attack.

full ensemble.title: Full Ensemble
full ensemble.text: A gear special rule. This armor gear is worn at every hit location. You may not equip armor gear at any hit location while wearing a Full Ensemble.

grace of power.title: Grace of Power
grace of power.text: A gear special rule. This weapon gains +1 strength for each red affinity you have.

grace of splendor.title: Grace of Splendor
grace of splendor.text: A gear special rule. Spend (m)(a) to gain +1 luck until the end of the round for every 2 blue affinities you have.

grace of valor.title: Grace of Valor
grace of valor.text: A gear special rule. When you depart, add {!} to all hit locations for every 2 green affinities you have.

grimstep.title: Grimstep
grimstep.text: A gear special rule. When you are attacking and Block a hit, you may move up to 6 consecutive spaces. If you do, your next wound attempt this attack gains strength equal to the number of spaces moved.

heroic.title: Heroic
heroic.text: A gear special rule. During your attack roll with this weapon, reroll any natural 1s. You must keep the new results.

honed.title: Honed X
honed.text: A gear special rule. This gear has +X strength. After successfully wounding a Super-Dense or Parry hit location, the edge is ruined and the weapon loses its bonus strength. Some effects allow you regain Hone benefits. When the survivors return to the settlement, all Honed gear is mended, regaining its lost strength.

impeccable.title: Impeccable
impeccable.text: A gear special rule. During your wound attempt with this weapon, reroll any natural 1s. You must keep the new results.

irreplaceable.title: Irreplaceable
irreplaceable.text: A gear special rule. If a survivor dies or ceases to exist, archive all irreplaceable gear in their gear grids.

leap.title: Leap
leap.text: A gear special rule. Spend (m)(a) to leap into the air! Place your survivor on an unoccupied space exactly 5 spaces away in a straight line, then activate a melee weapon with +2 accuracy and +5 strength.

locked.title: Locked
locked.text: A gear special rule. This gear cannot be disarmed.

meal.title: Meal - [Monster]
meal.text: A gear special rule. When you depart, consume this (do not archive) to gain its benefits. You can depart with only one meal. If a meal has a monster name, it is a unique meal from that monster gained via Supreme Cuisine.

outfit.title: Outfit
outfit.text: This completes an armor set if you're wearing the rest of the set and it shares a material keyword with the missing armor gear. For example, if you're wearing an Oxidized Lantern Helm and Phoenix Armor on every other hit location, you would gain the Phoenix Armor set bonus because the Phoenix Helm also has the metal keyword.

paired.title: Paired
paired.text: A gear special rule. Paired weapons are two weapons that are used as one. Add the speed of the second weapon when attacking with the first. These weapons must have the same name, and both must be in your gear grid.

perfect hit.title: Perfect Hit
perfect hit.text: An attack dice roll result of a Lantern 10. This always results in a hit. When there are multiple Perfect hits in a single attack, trigger any rules applying to Perfect hits that many times.

persistence.title: Persistence X
persistence.text: A gear special rule. On a Perfect hit, gain +X survival.

pounce.title: Pounce
pounce.text: A gear special rule. Spend (m)(a) to move 3 spaces forward in a straight line and activate a melee weapon. This attack gains +1 strength.

precision.title: Precision X
precision.text: A gear special rule. On a Perfect hit, inflict an automatic critical wound to the first X hit locations you resolve.

provoke.title: Provoke
provoke.text: A gear special rule. When you wound with this weapon, gain the priority target token.

puzzle affinity.title: Puzzle Affinity
puzzle affinity.text: A gear special rule. Puzzle affinity bonuses can only be gained if the affinities are completed using the affinities on that specific gear card (indicated by puzzle pieces instead of boxes).

range.title: Range: X (Gear)
range.text: A gear special rule. Survivors this many or fewer spaces away from a monster may attack with this weapon. Ranged weapons cannot be used if field of view to the monster is blocked (by terrain with the Obstacle rule).

razor sharp.title: Razor Sharp
razor sharp.text: A gear special rule. When attacking with a Razor Sharp weapon, roll the Razor Sharp die and add the result (denoted by the number of pips) to your wound attempt. This is not a wound roll and cannot cause critical wounds.

reach.title: Reach X
reach.text: A gear special rule. Reach weapons are long enough to attack monsters when the survivor is not adjacent. Reach specifies the maximum number of spaces away that a survivor can attack with this weapon.

refined.title: Refined
refined.text: A gear special rule. When this fails to wound, you may reroll the wound attempt. Limit once per attack.

savage.title: Savage
savage.text: A gear special rule. After the first critical wound in an attack, savage weapons cause 1 additional wound. This rule does not trigger on Impervious hit locations.

sealed.title: Sealed
sealed.text: A gear special rule. Sealed gear has a bonus effect that can only be earned by training. A survivor can unseal the gear by declaring it as their weapon proficiency, forsaking the normal bonuses of selecting a weapon type. When the survivor reaches the specialization rank, they earn the effect listed after the Sealed special rule on the gear card. A survivor can only earn a gear's Sealed bonus once per lifetime. Example: A survivor declares Toxicimitar as their weapon proficiency (because it has a Sealed effect). When they reach rank 3 (specialization), they gain the Crescent Step secret fighting art.

selfish.title: Selfish (Gear)
selfish.text: A gear special rule. Selfish gear cannot be in the same gear grid with any other gear with the "other" keyword.

sentient.title: Sentient
sentient.text: A gear special rule. A survivor must be insane to activate this gear.

shadow walk.title: Shadow Walk
shadow walk.text: A special type of movement. When you Shadow Walk, you may move through spaces survivors occupy without causing collision. (You cannot end your movement on spaces survivors occupy.)

sharp.title: Sharp
sharp.text: A gear special rule. Add 1d10 strength to each wound attempt using this gear. This d10 is not a wound roll, and cannot cause critical wounds nor automatically fail.

skewer.title: Skewer
skewer.text: After you Slam, spend (a) to move 1 space and activate a melee weapon with +2 strength. If you wound with a spear, apply that wound roll result to the next selected hit location this attack.

slam.title: Slam
slam.text: A gear special rule. Spend (m) and full move forward in a straight line. If you move 4+ spaces and stop adjacent to a monster, it suffers knock back 1 and -1 toughness until the end of the round.

slow.title: Slow
slow.text: A gear special rule. Slow weapons always have an attack speed of 1. Do not add speed modifiers.

surpass.title: Surpass X
surpass.text: A gear special rule. When your wound attempt total surpasses the monster's toughness by X or more, the monster suffers an additional wound.

undeathable.title: Undeathable
undeathable.text: A special rule. If the survivor would die, roll 1d10. On a result of 6+, instead the survivor lives. If this roll occurs from the survivor having a lethal amount of bleeding tokens, the survivor will not die until they gain another bleeding token.

unique.title: Unique
unique.text: A gear special rule. A settlement may only have one copy of this gear card at a time.

unshakable.title: Unshakable
unshakable.text: A gear special rule. When this survivor draws a trap card, roll 1d10. On a result of 6+, ignore the trap. Discard it and shuffle the hit location deck.

unshakeable.title: Unshakable
unshakeable.text: A gear special rule. When this survivor draws a trap card, roll 1d10. On a result of 6+, ignore the trap. Discard it and shuffle the hit location deck.

unstoppable.title: Unstoppable
unstoppable.text: A gear special rule. Replace all wound rolls with a 1d10 roll. On a 1-5, fail to wound, on 6+ wound. You cannot cause a critical wound while using this rule.

unwieldy.title: Unwieldy
unwieldy.text: A gear special rule. If any attack dice roll results are 1, the weapon causes 1 random damage to the survivor for each 1 rolled. Continue the attack as normal.

vital.title: Vital
vital.text: A gear special rule. If the settlement has any gear with this rule, the survivors cannot depart without this gear. If the survivor holding Vital gear perishes before the showdown, another survivor must pick up the Vital gear (discarding gear to make room in their grid if needed).
